rareResources.name: Neutronium Keel
rareResources.desc: A spine of degenerate matter laid down first, so that everything built above it has something that will not bend.

rareResources.name: Zero-Point Capacitor
rareResources.desc: It draws on the vacuum itself and gives back a little less than it takes, which is enough.

rareResources.name: Antihydrogen Reservoir
rareResources.desc: A gram of antihydrogen suspended in nothing, waiting a very long time to touch something.

rareResources.name: Frame-Dragging Gyroscope
rareResources.desc: It measures how a station's own turning drags spacetime along behind it, and corrects the drift before anyone aboard can feel it.

rareResources.name: Closed Ecology Column
rareResources.desc: Algae, water and light in a loop that has to close perfectly, because out here there is nothing left to top it up with.
